notes: Deploy only Pepeolithic (PEPEO) on Ethereum mainnet, chain ID 1, selected by the deployment service. The 16 static constructor arguments are coin (existing ZTO), admin, adam, seatRoot, startTime, caveLength, roundLength, firstPrice, floorPrice, then seven right-zero-padded ASCII bytes32 labels in cave order. Admin and Adam are the explicit addresses in the approved brief. ZTO decimals (18) and dead (0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD) are contract constants, not arguments. The nonpayable constructor makes no external calls and mints Zero (id 0) to Adam and One (id 736) to admin. The remaining 735 pieces comprise 400 sale pieces and 335 seat pieces. Start is 1791810000; caves last 86400 seconds and rounds 3600 seconds. Prices are ZTO base units: 1000000000000000000000000 first and 10000000000000000000000 floor. Purchases transfer ZTO directly from buyer to dead. Admin receives unsold sale pieces through permissionless post-close sweeps, receives the fixed 1% royalty, and alone may freeze each cave's metadata base once. No ownable, pausable or upgradeable mechanism; no initialization calls or deployment funding.
